note: Sixteen candidate paintings for the repainted demo (issue #227): twelve from two checkpoints x two poses x seeds 71004-71006, two from the wide pose, and those two again after the hand detailer. Every one was read by eye at full resolution, at the hands; the reading is one line each. Only the chosen one is published as an image. Identity, costume, style, negatives, sampler, latent, upscale and ControlNet settings are generation.json's for every row; what differs is the variant's checkpoint, control and pose words.
